podcast.body: Released on August 21, 2015, this self-titled album marked a significant shift in Nathaniel Rateliff's sound towards a more soulful direction. It initially started slow but gained widespread attention after a particular song from it went viral, leading to his breakthrough at age 37. "A self-titled album arrived on August 21, 2015. It started slow, but then this song went viral."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
